args.title: Announcing CSV Export: Take Your Reports Anywhere
args.body:
We're excited to announce that CSV export is now available!

Starting Tuesday 12 November, you can export any report as a CSV file — and it's available on all plans.

## What you can do

From the **Reports → Export** menu, you can now download any report as a CSV file. The export includes all columns currently shown in the report, so what you see is exactly what you get.

## Why you'll love it

- **Work with your data in any tool** — open your reports in Excel, Google Sheets, or your favourite analytics platform.
- **Build custom workflows** — feed report data into scripts, dashboards, or external systems.
- **Share easily** — send a clean, portable file to teammates or stakeholders who don't have access to the app.

## How to get started

1. Head to **Reports**.
2. Select the report you'd like to export.
3. Click **Export** and choose CSV.

That's it — your report is ready to download.

## Availability

CSV export is live from **Tuesday 12 November** and is included on **all plans** at no extra cost.

Questions or feedback? Drop us a line and let us know how you plan to put CSV export to work.

args.title: New Saturday Phone Support Hours – Starting 30 November
args.body:
We're excited to announce a change that we hope will make getting help a little easier for all of our customers: **phone support will now be available on Saturdays**, starting **30 November**.

## What's changing?

From 30 November, our phone support line will be open **Saturdays from 9 am to 1 pm**. Whether you're working through a weekend project, troubleshooting a weekend issue, or simply prefer to reach us outside the standard work week, you'll now have a direct phone line to our support team.

## What stays the same?

- **Live chat** remains available **around the clock**, 24/7, as always.
- **Weekday phone support hours** are unchanged.

## Why we're doing this

We've heard from many of you that weekend issues can't wait until Monday. Adding a Saturday phone window gives you another convenient option to talk directly to a support agent without having to hold your project until the week starts.

## How to reach us on Saturday

- **Phone:** Call our support line between 9 am and 1 pm on Saturday.
- **Live chat:** Available 24/7, including outside of phone support hours.

We hope this makes it easier for you to get the help you need, exactly when you need it. As always, thank you for your patience and for being part of our community.

If you have questions about the new hours or anything else, drop us a message via live chat or reach out during regular support hours.

- **Weekday hours:** No changes – our standard Monday-to-Friday schedule remains exactly the same.

## Why we're doing this

We know that for many of our customers, weekends are the only time they can step away from work and sort things out. Adding Saturday phone support means you won't have to wait until Monday to get the help you need.

- **Phone (Saturdays):** 9 am – 1 pm, starting 30 November
- **Phone (Weekdays):** As usual
- **Live chat:** Anytime, day or night

args.body:
We're excited to announce that CSV export is now available to everyone!

Starting Tuesday 12 November, you can export any of your reports as a CSV file — and it's available on all plans, free of charge.

**How to use it**

Head to **Reports → Export**, select the report you'd like to download, and choose CSV as your format. That's it — your data is ready to go.

**What's included**

Your CSV exports include all columns currently shown in the report, so you get exactly the data you're looking at, ready to open in Excel, Google Sheets, or any other tool of your choice.

Whether you're sharing numbers with your team, building your own dashboards, or running analysis in a spreadsheet, CSV export makes it easy to work with your data the way you want.

If you have any questions or feedback, we'd love to hear from you.

Happy exporting!

args.title: Announcing CSV Export: Take Your Reports Anywhere
args.body:
# Announcing CSV Export: Take Your Reports Anywhere

We're excited to announce a long-requested feature: **CSV export** for all of your reports. Starting **Tuesday, 12 November**, you'll be able to export any report as a CSV file — and it's available on **all plans**.

## What you can do

Head to **Reports → Export** and pick any report to export. The resulting CSV file includes **all columns currently shown** in that report, so what you see is exactly what you get.

## Why it matters

CSV is a universal format that opens in spreadsheet tools like Excel and Google Sheets, and feeds easily into your own data pipelines. Whether you're building a weekly digest, sharing numbers with a stakeholder, or pulling data into another analysis tool, CSV export makes it simple to move your reporting data wherever you need it.

## How to get started

1. Open the report you want to export.
2. Navigate to **Reports → Export**.
3. Choose CSV and download your file.

That's it — no add-ons, no upgrades required. CSV export is included on every plan from 12 November.

Have feedback or ideas for what to export next? We'd love to hear from you.
